title: A Quiet Tanzania: Trips for People Who Like Space
excerpt: Not a fan of crowds? A quiet Tanzania trip with remote parks, small camps and private experiences.
body:
## Quiet parks

- [Ruaha](/blog/ruaha-national-park-guide/).
- [Katavi](/blog/katavi-national-park-guide/).
- [Mahale](/blog/mahale-mountains-chimpanzees/).
- [Mkomazi](/blog/mkomazi-rhino-sanctuary/).

## Quiet areas in the Serengeti

The far north outside the migration, the Western Corridor, the eastern Serengeti.

## Small camps

Camps with only a few tents.

## Private vehicle

Your own pace.

## Season

The green season is quieter.

## Kilimanjaro

The [Northern Circuit](/blog/kilimanjaro-northern-circuit-guide/) is the quietest route.

[Plan your quiet trip](/travel-proposal/).
